turns.text: Lloyd, can you check the server logs for the last hour? I'm seeing some latency spikes.
Sure, checking now. I see several timeouts around 14:30 UTC. Is this related to the database migration?
Possibly. Also, did you see that Wan article? I remember it was in January 2025 when they first announced the beta.
I'll keep that in mind. Regarding the logs, do you want me to restart the service?
No, just monitor it. The weather is terrible outside anyway, so I'm staying in to watch it.
Understood. I'll send an alert if the error rate exceeds 5%.
Great. Also, my pizza order should be here in 20 minutes.
Enjoy. Let me know if you need anything else from the logs.
Hey Lloyd, I need to update the 'Recent News' section on the internal wiki.
Sure. What specific item are you updating?
The entry for Wan. I was wrong before, it wasn't January 2025. It was actually mentioned in AI news in April 2026.
Got it. I've noted that the correct date is April 2026.
Thanks. Also, did you fix that bug in the login script?
Yes, the patch was deployed at 10 AM.
Perfect. I'm going to grab a coffee now.
Enjoy. Let me know if you need help with the wiki update.
